summary: Insight Molecular Diagnostics Inc. filed an 8-K/A correcting a prior filing: a Specimen Collection Agreement with Quest Diagnostics was inadvertently filed under Item 1.01 and is now moved to Item 8.01 (Other Events). The agreement covers specimen collection services for iMDx's GraftAssureCore test, a blood test for donor-derived cell-free DNA. No transaction terms, prices, or shareholder actions are disclosed. This is a routine commercial agreement correction, not a special situation. No deal terms, board actions, or strategic review are present. No risk-arb or structural event is indicated. This is purely an administrative correction.
